content: React 19 useOptimistic(state, updateFn) is the standard hook for optimistic list mutations (add/edit/delete) under Server Actions: pass current list as state, dispatch an optimistic entry (with a temp client-generated id) before the Server Action resolves, then let revalidatePath/revalidateTag replace it with real server data on success. Rollback is implicit -- optimistic state only exists between dispatch and settle, so on error the list reverts automatically once the promise rejects and real state is unchanged. Common rollback bugs come from not carrying a stable client mutation id through the round trip to match placeholder->real replacement precisely.
